title: Catalog onboarding does not enroll new projects in the knowledge-transport cutover, so the cage daemon retries host-path discovery forever
wanted_capability: A project onboarded through the producer catalog-onboard route after the knowledge-transport cutover should be treated as producer-transported from the start. Today the knowledge lifecycle reconciliation (knowledge_lifecycle.rs) skips only projects covered by the knowledge-transport cutover marker; every project onboarded since that ceremony is not covered, so on every boot and reconciliation cycle the daemon calls acquire_selected_project_access for ArtifactWatchDiscovery on its host-local attachment, which cannot canonicalize a checkout-host path from the cage, and logs "checkout reconciliation skipped unavailable discovery authority ... attachment_inactive". The knowledge and gap view overlays hit the same path and emit one "gap store overlay skipped ... checkout authority root cannot be canonicalized" diagnostic per new project on every bbox_gaps and bbox_knowledge call, and publisher_status renders the sibling overlays as "the attachment is detached" although the attachments are active. Twelve projects onboarded on 2026-09-03 show this. Wanted: onboarding (or the accepted-publication establish with a producer binding) should extend knowledge-transport coverage to the project, or the reconciliation and overlay paths should treat a producer-bound accepted publication as authority and skip local discovery without a warning. The offline knowledge-transport-cutover CLI ceremony is the only enrollment path today and needs the daemon stopped.
missing_primitive: automatic knowledge-transport coverage for producer-onboarded projects, or producer-binding-aware reconciliation that does not fall back to local discovery
fallback_used: None; the warnings and overlay diagnostics are cosmetic once the accepted publication is producer-bound. Enrolling through the offline knowledge-transport-cutover ceremony would require another daemon maintenance window.
evidence: src/server/knowledge_lifecycle.rs reconcile_dark_knowledge_checkouts: discovery loop skips only knowledge_transport_cutover-covered projects, else acquire_selected_project_access(ArtifactWatchDiscovery) and WARN 'checkout reconciliation skipped unavailable discovery authority'
crates/bbox-indexing/src/checkout_access_v2.rs canonical_directory maps canonicalize failure to AttachmentInactive

src/server/open.rs and src/server/routes.rs sync_kb_project_roots: every uncovered project becomes a gap/knowledge carrier; crates/bbox-gaps/src/gaps.rs load_project_entries records degraded_carriers; src/tools/gaps.rs and src/tools/knowledge.rs emit 'store overlay skipped' per call
src/server/knowledge_view.rs OverlayDegradation::from_checkout_access renders AttachmentInactive as 'the attachment is detached'
src/server/code_source.rs catalog_onboard never extends the cutover marker; marker loaded once at boot in src/server/open.rs, written only by ProjectCatalogKnowledgeTransportCutoverFacadeV1::apply
crates/bbox-indexing/src/knowledge_transport_cutover.rs classify_project returns Uncovered without consulting a producer binding
src/bin/blackbox.rs execute_knowledge_transport_cutover --apply/--verify require the daemon stopped
notes: Triage trace at a66c6813: still relevant; live bbox_gaps diagnostics still show one 'gap store overlay skipped ... checkout authority root cannot be canonicalized' row. Correction: the per-call diagnostic comes from the gap/knowledge stores' degraded carrier list (recorded at carrier load), not the view overlays. An unmerged hygiene commit only rate-limits the reconciliation WARN; it adds no coverage.
